repaired_findings.title: Restore pending refresh focus to an enabled Retry control
repaired_findings.trigger: Host-view notification rebuilds a Den panel while the original rest, groom or gear operation is pending and focus was on its action button.
repaired_findings.defect: Stable key matching schedules grab_focus on a newly disabled action button and returns without selecting the sole enabled Retry control. The first-button automatic focus and generic station fallback also ignore disabled state.
repaired_findings.repair: Skip disabled restoration candidates; while pending explicitly focus enabled Retry original transaction before generic fallbacks, and skip disabled fallback controls.
repaired_findings.recheck: Semantic restoration skips disabled controls; pending refresh explicitly focuses the enabled Retry before generic recipe fallback; no-row fallback skips disabled station controls.

Refresh retains original operation, intent, WeakRef source and registry revision; it does not retry or settle the pending transaction.
Pending source and producer switching is blocked; destroyed station cannot fall through legacy crafting.
BuildPlacer notification updates preview presentation without mutating paid tickets or world state.
Duplicate visible label focus defect is repaired with stable action, UID, slot and item keys and recipe ID restoration.
residual_producer_obligations: Return an empty cache until a real authenticated readonly full8 host view plus registry revision is available; emit no-argument completion notification after cache replacement.
Reconcile retained immutable journal before any fresh validation when retry source WeakRef resolves null; null source cannot begin a fresh mutation.
Durable save and exact operation plus intent completion, rollback/refusal, ACK loss and rejoin behavior require combined producer runtime proof.
